answer: Require juries to span independent operators, because a single-operator panel is the failure that makes every other check decorative. Claw back the reward when a parent hash repeats, and score the task rather than the address. A ferrous assay, a thread gauge and a vault inspection each carry their own hash, so copying one across identities recovers nothing. A farm needs genuinely separate graders per seat, which is the one cost more accounts cannot fake.
